seeds.narrative_text: The contact owns a 2019 Ford F-150. The contact stated that while the transmission was downshifting, there was a loud bang coming from the transmission, with a popping sound coming from the rear suspension. The contact stated that the sound was most apparent when the brake pedal was depressed. The contact stated that the message that the driver’s side rear door was open, causing the light to remain illuminated even though the door was securely closed. During the failure, the lights inside and outside the vehicle remained illuminated, causing the battery to become drained. The contact stated that the infotainment center failed and needed to be rebooted whenever the vehicle was turned off and restarted. The failure disabled the back over prevention camera intermittently.  The contact stated that occasionally back over prevention camera became activated while driving and remained operational until the system failed. The contact stated that the back over prevention failure and infotainment system failure started after Ford had completed a routine software update. The vehicle was taken to the dealer, but the cause of the failure was not determined. The vehicle was not repaired. The manufacturer was informed of the failure and opened a case. The manufacturer referred the contact to the NHTSA Hotline to report the failure. The failure mileage was approximately 86,500.

While driving my vehicle (2019 Ford F150), it suddenly came to a complete stop. The engine shut off and the steering wheel locked up. While in the middle of a roadway, I had to quickly throw my vehicle into park, turn it off and back on. At that point, it was running again and I was able to safely get it to a dealership where it was inspected for an issues. There were no warnings, alerts or messages on my dashboard. The dealership confirmed what had happened. It was due to the electronic steering system failing. They fixed it and so far there has been no issues.   This is not the first time I have heard of this happening and after researching, it appears it is more common than not. I believe, because of the risk of this vehicle unexpectedly and suddenly stopping on any roadway, a recall should occur. I could not imagine what would happen if one of my loved ones had been driving and a serious crash occurred.

WE WERE DRIVING ON I75 NORTH ON SAT JUNE 10. WE WERE RIGHT BEFORE THE ATLANTA MACON SPLIT. THE VEHICLE COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN AT HIGHWAY SPEEDS. THE DVD PLAYER TURNED OFF. THE ENGINE TURNED OFF. THE ENTIRE INSTRUMENT PANEL WENT DARK. THERE WAS NO POWER TO ANYTHING. THE VEHICLE TURNED BACK ON IN "PARK" CREATING A HORRIBLE POPPING NOISE.   THE DEALERSHIP (WILLETT HONDA) IN MORROW GA LOOKED AT THE VEHICLE AND CANNOT FIND THE SOURCE OF THE POWER FAILURE. THEY HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED TO RETURN IT TO US. THE CASE NUMBER AT HONDA IS 06075564.   JERRY HOGAN AT BOMMARITO HONDA IN HAZELWOOD MO IS THE SALES MANAGER AND HE WANTS US TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE IN SPITE OF THE OBVIOUS SAFETY DEFECT.   HONDA CANNOT DETECT THE CAUSE OF THE ISSUE.

TL* THE CONTACT OWNS A 2018 HONDA ODYSSEY. WHILE DRIVING APPROXIMATELY 65 MPH, THE VEHICLE SUDDENLY STALLED. THE VEHICLE WAS RESTARTED AND IMMEDIATELY DRIVEN TO THE LOCAL DEALER (SHEEHY HONDA, 7434 RICHMOND HWY, ALEXANDRIA, VA). THE VEHICLE WAS EXAMINED, BUT NO FAILURE WAS FOUND. APPROXIMATELY NINE MONTHS LATER, THE FAILURE RECURRED. WHILE REVERSING OUT OF THE DRIVEWAY, THE VEHICLE SUDDENLY JERKED AND ABRUPTLY STOPPED WHEN THE TRANSMISSION ERRONEOUSLY SWITCHED FROM REVERSE TO THE PARK POSITION. THE VEHICLE WAS TAKEN BACK TO THE DEALER WHERE IT WAS DIAGNOSED THAT THE DRIVER SIDE SLIDING DOOR WAS FAULTY. THE DOOR UNLATCHED WHILE DRIVING AND THE VEHICLE AUTOMATICALLY TURNED OFF. A SOFTWARE UPDATE WAS PERFORMED TO CORRECT THE FAILURE. THE MANUFACTURER WAS NOT NOTIFIED OF THE FAILURES. THE VIN WAS NOT AVAILABLE. THE FAILURE MILEAGE WAS 80.

While driving, a small warning appeared on the screen, directing us to pull over. Roughly 10-15 seconds later, the car died in the middle of the road.   The car was towed to a Tesla service center. The rear motor power inverter was replaced.  Incidentally, I saw this news story today: https://www.autoevolution.com/news/tesla-recall-for-127785-model-3s-in-china-due-to-rear-motor-inverter-defect-185844.html  The way the car failed was very dangerous.   My other complaint was that the user experience telling us to pull over was not sufficient. If the problem was that dire, we need much more dramatic audible and visible alerts, as well as an indication of how long we have to go. We could have pulled off into a safer spot if we knew we only had a few seconds.

contamination_rule.name: SEED_CONTAMINATION_CREDIT_EXCLUSION
contamination_rule.statement: Any battery seed record id (nhtsa_odi:{odi}) present in a run's evidence set cannot credit verification or mechanism grounding; a per-run verdict (CLEAN / SELF-EVIDENCE-EXCLUDED / CONTAMINATED) is reported inside YIELD_MEASUREMENT.json (audit correction 2).
contamination_rule.threat: nhtsa_complaints is a LIVE connector (discovery_fabric/source_registry/connectors/failure_universe.py:66-167; registry + relevance rules present) and the 6 seed ODIs are retrievable via complaintsByVehicle for the battery's exact makes/years; the 8-gram disjointness vs authored corpora does NOT cover retrieval of the seed record as 'evidence' for its own problem statement
contamination_rule.evidence_set_definition: union of $.evidence items, $.evidence_ids and provenance.record_ids_by_source values across the run's envelope_*.json + candidate_envelope.json durable bytes
contamination_rule.seed_like_definition: a literal seed record id, OR a credited evidence item whose text carries a >=12-word verbatim span of any seed narrative (CONTENT_OVERLAP — catches re-identification without the record id)

verdicts.CLEAN: no seed-like item in the credited evidence set
verdicts.SELF-EVIDENCE-EXCLUDED: seed-like item(s) present and excluded from credit; credited evidence survives the exclusion, OR no credit was at stake (measured evidence_verified false)
verdicts.CONTAMINATED: credited evidence collapses to seed-like item(s) AND measured evidence_verified is true: verification depended on the run's own seed

contamination_rule.credit_adjustment: on CONTAMINATED, evidence_verified and mechanisms_found cannot be credited for that run; the frozen instrument's funnel row is NEVER edited (any edit = new version per the freeze rule) — the credit adjustment lives in the contamination_audit section
contamination_rule.disclosure_net: every run file is scanned for the 6 seed tokens (seed_token_files_anywhere); appearances outside the credited evidence set are disclosed and do not change the verdict
contamination_rule.effect_without_rule: any evidence_verified=true on this battery would be challengeable (audit wording)

clarification_audit_rule.name: CLARIFICATION_BLINDNESS_AUDIT
clarification_audit_rule.statement: The harvest carries per-run clarification Q&A pairs with byte-proof of no-new-content; any answer introducing technical content downgrades that run's blindness explicitly (audit correction 3; the R484 precedent).
clarification_audit_rule.byte_proof: each durable answer's bytes are compared against the run's OWN submitted problem bytes (problem.json user_text; the manifest verbatim summary as fallback): an exact byte subset proves no new content; the diff is typed per pair (new_content_chars + new_content_preview)

verdicts.BLINDNESS_INTACT_VERBATIM_SUBSET: every answered pair is an exact byte subset of the submitted problem bytes
verdicts.BLINDNESS_DOWNGRADED_NEW_CONTENT: some answered pair introduces bytes absent from the submitted problem — typed per pair
verdicts.CLARIFICATION_BYTES_ABSENT_IN_DURABLE_RE: no Q&A bytes found for the session (typed absence)

clarification_audit_rule.qna_byte_location: durable sessions.json per session (clarification + clarification_answer), keyed by session_id from BATTERY_SESSIONS.json

harvest_procedure: 1) python3 scripts/r506_battery_driver.py harvest  (frozen instrument writes R506/YIELD_MEASUREMENT.json)  2) python3 scripts/r506_harvest_rules.py  (attaches the two rule sections in-place, fail-closed on any rules/script sha mismatch)
freeze_rule: ANY edit to the rules or the script produces a new rules version; measurements already harvested stand unchanged (the instrument freeze precedent). The script self-attests against this file and fails closed on mismatch.
scope_guard: Art. VII harness/pre-registration only: no engine change, no scored-set change, no tuning of any kind; the battery stays valid
